Detailed but uncluttered. Historically and scientifically appropriate objects, clothing and setting. Avoid corporate vector icons, slick 3D rendering and childish cartoon style. High-quality, print-ready visual storytelling, matching a warm ivory-and-sage adult watercolor booklet.
